names.notes: Public Morocco frequency tables were used as a Morocco-administered-region sample seed for this disputed-territory GEO. This is not a Sahrawi civil registry source, so names remain review-quality.

phones.notes: ANRT confirms Morocco country code 212 and nine-digit national significant numbers, with fixed geographic numbers under 5 and mobile numbers under 6/7 after removing the domestic 0. The 528/529 fixed prefixes are retained as Morocco-linked southern-territory review prefixes; generated numbers are not assignment-checked.
